mapper.select: select snapshot_id, order_id, buyer_name, buyer_email, recipient_name, recipient_phone, country_code, state_code, city, district, address_line1, address_line2, postal_code, tax_rule_version, exchange_rate_version, exchange_rate, raw_address_json, create_time from order_snapshots where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: insert into order_snapshots (order_id, buyer_name, buyer_email, recipient_name, recipient_phone, country_code, state_code, city, district, address_line1, address_line2, postal_code, tax_rule_version, exchange_rate_version, exchange_rate, raw_address_json, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{buyerName}, #{buyerEmail}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{countryCode}, #{stateCode}, #{city}, #{district}, #{addressLine1}, #{addressLine2}, #{postalCode}, #{taxRuleVersion}, #{exchangeRateVersion}, #{exchangeRate}, #{rawAddressJson}, sysdate())
